## Example 4.3 · Simple and compound interest {#fm5-example-4-3-bc .fm-slide }

Jack invests \$16 000 at 12% p.a., with interest paid monthly for 11 years.

b) Find the simple interest earned at the same rate, paid monthly over the same time period.

c) By how much does the compound exceed the simple interest?

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 12 · Example 4.3 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
(b) $I=16000(0.12)(11)=21120$, equivalently $16000(0.01)(132)$. Simple interest paid monthly is not reinvested in this model. (c) $43503.33699-21120=22383.33699$, so the extra interest is \$22 383 to the nearest dollar, consistent with part (a), or \$22 383.34 if expressed to cents. Mention the rounding convention explicitly; do not compare compound balance against simple interest.
:::
